project.name: Sudoku Solver Visualizer
project.description: A static browser-based Sudoku solver visualizer that generates unique puzzles and animates multiple solving algorithms.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Browser entry point that loads local Tailwind, Alpine, the solver/generator/visualizer scripts, and declares the Sudoku board plus control/status UI.

nodes.name: style.css
nodes.summary: Custom responsive styling for Sudoku grid sizing, cell borders, candidate marks, status panels, algorithm controls, and mobile layout behavior.

nodes.name: solver.js
nodes.summary: Core Sudoku validation and solving module. Exposes backtracking, MRV, constraint propagation, and human-logic trace builders under a UMD-style browser/CommonJS wrapper.

nodes.name: generator.js
nodes.summary: Puzzle generator that creates solved boards, shuffles valid layouts, removes clues by difficulty, and enforces unique solvability.

nodes.name: visualizer.js
nodes.summary: Alpine state factory for puzzle lifecycle, algorithm selection, trace playback, timers, candidate display, status text, and dark mode persistence.

nodes.name: game.js
nodes.summary: CommonJS compatibility module that combines browser modules for Node-based logic and project tests.

nodes.name: sw.js
nodes.summary: Cache-first service worker that precaches static runtime assets and reloads clients when a new worker takes control.

nodes.name: manifest.json
nodes.summary: PWA manifest defining the Sudoku app identity, icons, theme color, display mode, and start URL.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Node package manifest with repeatable test scripts and Playwright as the browser smoke-test dependency.

nodes.name: netlify.toml
nodes.summary: Netlify static hosting configuration for serving the repository root without a build output directory.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Primary project documentation explaining purpose, local setup, controls, algorithms, architecture, PWA behavior, and deployment.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Agent-facing project guide describing scope, stack, design decisions, workflow, deployment, and out-of-scope features.

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Companion agent instructions and project context for Claude-oriented development sessions.

nodes.name: implementation-notes.md
nodes.summary: Running implementation notes capturing design decisions, algorithm additions, layout work, and tradeoffs over time.

nodes.name: release-checklist.md
nodes.summary: Deployment checklist for validating tests, PWA cache versions, assets, and release readiness before publishing.

nodes.name: game.test.js
nodes.summary: Node assert test suite covering solver validity, trace contracts, generator uniqueness, visualizer lifecycle, algorithm selection, and timing behavior.

nodes.name: project.test.js
nodes.summary: Project guardrail tests for setup, documentation, local vendor assets, PWA cache references, and static-site assumptions.

nodes.name: smoke.test.js
nodes.summary: Playwright smoke test for browser workflow verification against the static app.

nodes.name: generate_icons.py
nodes.summary: Utility script for producing PWA icon files used by the manifest and HTML metadata.

nodes.name: sudoku_solver.py
nodes.summary: Original Python backtracking Sudoku solver kept as historical reference for the browser visualizer evolution.

nodes.name: Sudoku game design spec
nodes.summary: Original design spec for the Sudoku web experience and early game/visualizer direction.

nodes.name: Constraint propagation spec
nodes.summary: Specification for adding constraint propagation as a distinct visual solving algorithm.

nodes.name: Human logic v3 spec
nodes.summary: Future-facing specification for expanding human logic strategies with advanced techniques such as X-Wing and Swordfish.

nodes.name: isValid
nodes.summary: Checks whether a digit can be placed in a row, column, and 3x3 box without violating Sudoku givens.

nodes.name: hasValidGivens
nodes.summary: Validates board shape, digit range, and duplicate-free givens before solving or tracing.

nodes.name: solvePuzzle
nodes.summary: Mutating depth-first solver used as a reference solution and solvability check.

nodes.name: countSolutions
nodes.summary: Counts solutions up to a cap so generator can reject non-unique layouts.

nodes.name: createBacktrackingTrace
nodes.summary: Builds a place/backtrack trace using naive reading-order DFS.

nodes.name: createMrvTrace
nodes.summary: Builds a place/backtrack trace using the Minimum Remaining Values heuristic.

nodes.name: createConstraintPropagationTrace
nodes.summary: Builds a candidate-snapshot trace using propagation waves, guesses, and contradictions.

nodes.name: createHumanLogicTrace
nodes.summary: Builds named human-logic deduction traces with singles and naked pairs.

nodes.name: createHumanLogicV2Trace
nodes.summary: Adds hidden pairs, pointing pairs/triples, and box-line reduction to human-logic tracing.

nodes.name: generateTestPuzzle
nodes.summary: Attempts complete-board generation, clue removal, solvability preflight, and uniqueness validation for a selected difficulty.

nodes.name: sudokuGame
nodes.summary: Creates the Alpine component state and methods that drive the visible app.

nodes.name: runSolver
nodes.summary: Measures the selected trace builder, initializes counters and board state, then starts interval-based playback.

nodes.name: finishNow
nodes.summary: Completes the current puzzle immediately by recomputing the selected trace, applying final counts, filling the solved board, and updating status.

layers.name: App Shell
layers.description: HTML, styling, PWA metadata, and service-worker assets that make the static browser app load and installable.

layers.name: Sudoku Domain Logic
layers.description: Solver and generator modules plus key exported functions that validate boards, create unique puzzles, and build algorithm traces.

layers.name: Visualizer State
layers.description: Alpine state and playback controls that connect generated puzzles and trace builders to the visible board, timers, counters, and statuses.

layers.name: Testing
layers.description: Node and browser checks that protect solver behavior, visualizer lifecycle, project setup, and browser smoke workflows.

layers.name: Documentation
layers.description: Human and agent-facing documentation, release notes, implementation history, and feature specs/plans.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README and agent guide to understand that this is a static Sudoku solver visualizer, not a manual Sudoku game.

tour.title: Browser App Shell
tour.description: Inspect the HTML, CSS, manifest, and service worker to see how the no-build static app loads Alpine, local assets, and PWA behavior.

tour.title: Solver Trace Contract
tour.description: Read the solver module to see the shared trace shape used by backtracking, MRV, constraint propagation, and human-logic algorithms.

tour.title: Puzzle Generation
tour.description: Follow generation from a complete shuffled board through clue removal, solvability checks, and uniqueness enforcement.

tour.title: Visualizer Playback
tour.description: See how Alpine state chooses an algorithm, builds a trace, animates steps, updates counters, supports finish-now, and reports status.

tour.title: Verification Path
tour.description: Use the tests to understand the expected behavior for solver logic, generated layouts, visualizer lifecycle, static assets, and browser smoke workflow.

tour.title: Release Readiness
tour.description: Finish with release documentation and deployment config to understand how the static site is checked and served on Netlify.
